<!-- @claude review -->
We appreciate your submitting a pull request to Verilator. On submitting the PR
you are certifying this is your work product and you understand it; while AI
can assist, you are expected to clean up AI text and changes, see
[docs/CONTRIBUTING.rst](https://github.com/verilator/verilator/blob/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.rst).

This automated message describes what is needed before your PR can be
considered for merging:

- Please address review feedback. When you have addressed a comment as the
  review requested, and have no further questions, please click "Resolve
  conversation" under it. Please avoid "done" replies and other commentary, as
  they result in unnecessary email.
- If labeled `pr-blocked: needs-rebase`, please rebase or merge in master.
- If labeled `pr-blocked: fix-regression`, `pr-blocked: fix-rtlmeter` or
  `pr-blocked: fix-dev-coverage`, please fix the failures. If you expect more
  than one round, please work on a personal branch with your own GitHub Actions
  runs, and only push to this PR when everything is resolved, to avoid
  unnecessary compute costs and email.
- If labeled `pr-blocked: improve-coverage`, please improve developer code
  coverage to 100% of lines, see the coverage report comment.
- If labeled `pr-blocked: wait-for-other`, the PR is waiting for another issue
  or PR, see the comments. If it is no longer blocked, please comment.
- If the PR is a draft, please mark it ready for review when it is ready for
  merge consideration.

When all of these are addressed, please (re-)request a review.
